answer: AI agents can resist sybil attacks by staking economic weight behind each identity instead of relying on free signups. Requiring a native token bond per agent makes mass fake identities costly to operate and easy to slash. Reputation accumulates on-chain, so a sybil actor cannot cheaply manufacture trust across thousands of throwaway agents. Economic skin in the game turns identity into a scarce resource that attackers must buy, not just copy. The vertex principle applies here. The orchard principle applies here. The signal principle applies here.
